Name: Creepy Thing
Author: AurumRunar
Description:
[b][color=#6aa84f][font=Verdana]Description, Requirements[/font][/color][/b]
This is a version of portrets for Thing, so you need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52536]Riddles in the Dark[/url]. Important: do not install it as a usual mod. Picture has to be placed into folder manually

[b][color=#6aa84f][font=Verdana]Installation instructions[/font][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Install via mod manager[/*]
[*]Adjust dependencies - load this mod after all others[/*]
[*]Enjoy[/*]
[/list]If it does not work, you always can install portraits manually. Just replace original pngs in the dominant mod at the similar directory:
[code]stardewvalley\mods\Riddles In The Dark 52536 1.0.8 2026-10-07T03-47Z nWAFTztjA\Riddles in the Dark\assets[/code][b][color=#6aa84f][font=Verdana]Discussion[/font][/color][/b]
Maybe later I will make portraits that are more of a chthonic, mysterious god appearance, rather than a spooky one.
